basics.name: Mallikarjuna Tupakula
basics.label: ML Researcher | AI Safety & Science
basics.summary: Independent student researcher pursuing MS in Computer Science at Rochester Institute of Technology with full graduate scholarship. Focused on AI Safety, AI for Science, Multimodal Learning, and NeuroAI. Published sole-author work at NeurIPS'25 FM4LS workshop.

work.name: Rochester Institute of Technology
work.summary: Independent student researcher working on AI Safety, AI for Science, Multimodal Learning, and NeuroAI. Advisor: Prof. Ashique KhudaBukhsh
highlights: Sole-authored publication at NeurIPS 2025 (FM4LS) on 'Thin Bridges for Drug Text Alignment: Lightweight Contrastive Learning for Target Specific Drug Retrieval' - achieving Recall@1 = 0.762 on ChEMBL and 3× scaffold-split gain over baselines

Co-authored publication in INFORMS Journal on Computing: developed multimodal machine-comprehension framework evaluating 48,956 YouTube Kids videos; achieved 77.5% accuracy on ScienceQA and F1 = 0.82 on CVQA dataset
Developing diffusion-based brain decoding pipelines using fMRI data and image reconstruction for multimodal perception tasks with Stable Diffusion and CLIP embeddings

Developing large-scale empathetic dialogue systems using CANDOR dataset (1 TB video/audio/text) and studying LLM neuron interpretability to align multimodal agents with human values for safer reasoning in medical and financial domains

work.name: Indian School of Business
work.summary: Research Assistant in Pre-doctoral Program working on AI for Social Good and AI Safety problems on social media platforms. Advisor: Prof. Sumeet Kumar
highlights: Worked on AI for Social Good and AI Safety problems on social media platforms by processing large multimodal datasets (YouTube, Amazon, Twitter) at TeraBytes scale, leading to publications at AAAI, ASONAM, INFORMS, and ACL
Applied PyTorch, OpenCV, and CUDA to accelerate large-scale computer vision pipelines, optimizing training and inference speed for terabyte-scale datasets
Publications at top-tier venues: NeurIPS, ACL, ASONAM, INFORMS Journal on Computing, INFORMS on Data Science, and AAAI
Awarded prestigious Kathuria Pre-Doctoral Scholarship from Shri Nihal Chand Kathuria Education Trust

work.name: Spacept
work.summary: Research Intern on Core ML Team developing deep learning solutions for satellite imagery analysis. Advisor: Sergiu Iliev (Founder)
highlights: Developed a custom Deep Learning model for oil spill classification using Google Earth Engine and Sentinel satellite data of the Mauritius oil spill (July 2020), engineering scalable pipelines and augmentations
Improved accuracy from 65% to 78%, demonstrating transferability to real-world autonomous sensing applications

work.name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras
work.summary: Research Intern on Neuromotor Team working on medical imaging and CT reconstruction. Advisor: Prof. Srinivasa Chakravarthy
highlights: Implemented Elman-Jordan-based CT reconstruction halving projections (360 → 180) for efficient imaging AI techniques extendable to on-device simulation

work.name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore
work.position: Research Intern | Research and Development Team
work.summary: Research Intern on R&D Team analyzing real-time sales data and marketing analytics. Advisor: Prof. Trilochan Sastry
highlights: Analyzed real-time data sales from Farmveda and predicted future sales, even further improving the sales by being actively involved in the Digital Marketing team
